claude.performance_metric: net income $130.7M (FY2012), up from $98.5M (FY2010); no asset impairments in window
claude.rationale: The slice documents a positive realized trajectory: consecutive years of rising net sales and net income (FY2010–2012), zero asset impairments across 2009–2012, and both operating segments retained and growing (HSN +2%/+5%; Cornerstone +18%/+10%). No documented disruption at the product/process interface (only small brand-level portfolio adjustments within Cornerstone, e.g. Chasing Fireflies acquired, Smith+Noble and The Territory Ahead divested for $6.6M) supports p4=0. No documented friction between operations and organization/people (approximately 6,700 employees, no union representation, no reported integration conflict) supports p5=0.
